PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: Port the public domain proxies to. RustFS binds RUSTFS_ADDRESS (0.0.0.0:9000) and ignores $PORT, so Railway's domain must be told explicitly which container port to route to. Must stay 9000.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root username. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_USER}}.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}.
